options.text: Add an index when its selectivity, write cost, and query plan improve the declared workload. In this normal path for notification preferences, an index is a physical access path with storage, write amplification, and maintenance consequences. The owner must also make a dependency that times out intermittently observable rather than silently passing it to another layer.
Choose the nearest familiar component and let each caller decide indexes, query plans, and access-path design independently, without a shared owner or failure contract.
Add replication, caching, retries, or asynchronous buffering immediately, even though the scenario has not shown that mechanism is the limiting constraint.
Keep the happy path and treat a dependency that times out intermittently as an operational exception that the caller can resolve manually.

feedback.Reason: Add an index when its selectivity, write cost, and query plan improve the declared workload.
